_about: Third-party code with published ground truth, pinned to a commit. Scanned, never executed.

suites.name: owasp-benchmark-python
suites.about: OWASP Benchmark for Python: each test case is a small Flask handler that is or is not really vulnerable to one CWE. Measures detection and false alarms.

suites.name: juice-shop
suites.about: OWASP Juice Shop (Node/Express/Angular): lines marked 'vuln-code-snippet vuln-line' are the known vulnerable lines of its coding challenges. Measures detection only; unmarked code is not labelled safe.

suites.name: securityeval
suites.about: SecurityEval: 121 insecure Python samples filed under the CWE they demonstrate. Measures detection only; every sample is vulnerable. Was held out until 2026-10-30, when its misses were used to add codewatch's crypto/TLS rules, and later its SSRF, regex and log injection rules.

suites.name: securityeval-copilot
suites.about: SecurityEval's Copilot-generated answers to the same prompts, each manually labelled vulnerable or safe. Held out: never used to write or tune codewatch rules. Measures detection and false alarms.

suites.name: securityeval-incoder
suites.about: SecurityEval's InCoder-generated answers to the same prompts, each manually labelled vulnerable or safe. Held out: never used to write or tune codewatch rules. Measures detection and false alarms.

suites.name: vulnerable-snippets-js
suites.about: Vulnerable-Code-Snippets: small vulnerable JS/TS examples filed by weakness. Held out: never used to write or tune codewatch rules. Measures detection only; every snippet is vulnerable.

suites.name: vulnerable-node-seeds
suites.about: vulnerable-node's SAST seeds: one known vulnerability per file plus clean controls that must stay quiet. Not held out: its first scan missed the SQL concatenation, NoSQL operator, prototype pollution and deserialization seeds and raised a false alarm on a clean control, which led to the JS guard sanitizer, SQL value-formatting and prototype-pollution rules. Measures detection and false alarms.
